trade.LIPSYNC: Cheapest and fastest. Only the mouth moves over the new face.
trade.KLING: Natural head and hand movement, sharpest image. Costs several times more.
trade.SEEDANCE: Natural movement, a bit cheaper than Kling. Resolution follows the face area.

why.lipsyncOnly: Lipsync only uses the original audio. Pick Kling or Seedance to use the engine’s voice.
why.needsKeep: Only when keeping the winner’s edit. Start a new batch with it on.
why.notEnabled: Coming soon: we’re still testing that the engine keeps the same voice across stretches.
why.blocked: This winner’s edit can’t take the engine’s voice:
why.klingVoice: Kling’s voice changes between stretches — use Original audio.

explain.LIPSYNC: One continuous lipsync take of the winner’s audio over the new face. Edit, length and audio identical to the winner.
explain.A: {engine} animates the new face without sound, stretch by stretch, then lipsync puts the winner’s own audio on it. Edit, length and audio identical to the winner.

meta.blockedTitle: You can't manage ads on this account
meta.blockedBody: Ask the account owner to give you Advertiser (or higher) in Meta Business settings → Ad accounts → People. Then press Check again.

meta.blockedFundingBody: This ad account has an unpaid balance or no valid payment method. Settle it in Meta Billing (Business settings → Billing), then press Check again.
meta.disconnectBody: Home loses its results and Pick from Meta goes away until you connect again. Ads already published stay in your account.

oauth.META_UNAVAILABLE: Meta didn't answer. Try again in a moment.

meta.connectCardSub: Log in with the Facebook profile that manages {name}'s ads. You pick the ad account and Page on the next screen.
meta.perm1: Read your ad accounts, ads and 30 days of results
meta.perm2: Create ads in a campaign when you press Send
meta.perm3: Never: post on your Page, change budgets, pause ads on its own

why.title: Why connect
why.note: We read ads and results. We never post, pause or spend without a button you press.

hint.warn: You can continue. We will keep checking the pixel and tell you on Home.
hint.blocked: This account cannot be used yet. Skip for now and connect it later in Settings.

settings.title: Meta
settings.lede: Connect to see spend, CPA and ROAS on Home, pick winners from the account and send ads to a campaign.

result.activeBody: The ad is running in {account}. Pause here or in Ads Manager.

result.onlyAdmins: Only owners and admins can activate or pause.
result.retryHint: Retry resumes from the steps already done; nothing is duplicated.
result.noMetrics: No data yet: results arrive after the next sync.

brain.title: We're building {name}'s Brain
brain.body: Everything from setup is already in: business, offer, audience, goals. Every ad starts here. The more it knows, the better the ads; the missing items are a 5-minute job.

iterate.title: This ad is already working
iterate.body: From your Meta account: the ad marked here costs the least per result, under the account median. The fastest win is more versions of it. That is Iterate a winner.

concepts.title: Or start from a blank page
concepts.body: New concepts writes scripts from the Brain, picks a face, generates the scenes and edits the video. About 12 minutes, in the background; you get called when it needs you.

eddy.title: Eddy will read your campaigns
eddy.body: Soon you can ask Eddy what's tiring, what to scale and what to iterate, from the same numbers Home shows. Not live yet; you'll see it in the sidebar when it is.

home.title: Home is your scoreboard
home.body: Spend, cost per purchase, ROAS and the ads running, from Meta. The top ads to iterate, and whatever is waiting on you. That is the tour. Go make an ad.
